comments.body:
Stats: +2 Search, +1 Collection, unisex, 20k fame to equip.

Obtained: Songsunri Ruins dungeon; lower floor hidden passage (the one that has rock-hewn walls and has its treasure chests spread out at a distance) treasure chest. Somewhat rare. Also part of a Memorial Album, Treasure Hidden in Ruins (No.2), for whatever that may be worth.
